query:
SELECT t.id as "id!", t.name as "name!",
                  t.canary_triggered as "canary_triggered!: i64",
                  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.points_at_solve), 0) AS INTEGER) as "score!: i64"
           FROM teams t
           LEFT JOIN solves s ON s.team_id = t.id
           WHERE t.id = ?1
           GROUP BY t.id
